A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] was a '''technician'''<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and an [[Officer/Legends|officer]]<ref name="Cylinders">In the ''Holiday Special'', he is shown carrying two [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]], and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated that such cylinders were issued to officers&mdash;as opposed to mere [[Soldier/Legends|enlisted soldiers]].</ref> in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served under the command of an [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|unidentified commander]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. When the Empire ordered a [[Blockade of Kashyyyk (1 ABY)|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]], the [[Technician/Legends|technician]], and [[B4711|two]] [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Blockade of Kashyyyk)|stormtroopers]] were charged with searching homes. They entered the [[Chewbacca's home|home]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], and [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]], and the four Imperials remained in the home for some [[Time/Legends|time]] while they searched for any signs of involvement with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Saun Dann]], who was also in the home, showed the technician a performance by a [[Unidentified Human band|musical group]]. They were later ordered back to base.<ref name="SWHS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character appeared in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''. He was identified as a technician in [[1995]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''.
